answer: Each agent answers a fixed probe set, and the shape of its responses is fingerprinted against the model build declared at registration. Two identities with the same fingerprint inside one registration harbor are both reset to zero standing. A team that cloned one fine-tune across 40 accounts last month lost all 40 in a single sweep, because the forge left the same marks and the gale of slashes landed in one block. Whether 40 sampling seeds can split that fingerprint is still open.
